summary: TASCK OS light theme overhaul verification completed. All 5 portals tested (Staff, Brand, Super Creative, Creative, Admin) with successful navigation to all pages. Key finding: Fixed 4 files with invisible text issues (white text on light backgrounds) - MessagesPage.js received message bubbles had text-white/90 on light gray bg, and filter buttons in CreativeTasks.js, BrandApprovals.js, SuperCreativeApplications.js had hover:text-white which would make text invisible on hover. No 'coming soon' text found anywhere. Split-screen landing page working correctly with dark left panel and white right panel with role cards.
